name: What an Acceptance Registry Records
title: What an Acceptance Registry Records
description: An acceptance registry records each acceptance event: the build, the criteria, the evidence, the approver, the date, and any conditions. It is the permanent log of 'we said this was good'.
how_it_works: Define the registry entry format with required fields, and file an entry for every acceptance - no informal acceptances. The registry is the organization's memory of its commitments.
key_points: Build, criteria, evidence, approver, date, conditions.
requirements: Defined acceptance criteria per build; recorded acceptance evidence; registry with retention and retrieval.
standards: Records management practice; quality management system documentation.
